module: Parking spot marker for parking races: three stacked outlines (park_outline_marker.dae, height 1.2 m) and a striped ground decal (parkDecalStripes.png, via Engine.Render.DynamicDecalMgr), whose color is smoothed over time. It is not a classic checkpoint marker: it has no setToCheckpoint or setMode, it is set with setSpot and setColor. The module returns a constructor: require('scenario/raceMarkers/parkingraceSpotMarker')(id) gives an object of class C.
usage:
local m = require('scenario/raceMarkers/parkingraceSpotMarker')('spot1')
m:createMarkers()
m:setSpot(vec3(100, 50, 10), quat(0, 0, 0, 1), vec3(2.5, 5, 0.5))
m:setColor({0, 1, 0, 1})
m:show()
-- every frame:
m:update(dt)
notes: setSpot(pos, rot, scl): pos is the center, scl is the FULL size of the spot on each axis. The XY scale of the outlines follows the parkingMarker.lua convention (scl.y / 2.05).

setColor accepts {r, g, b, a} (indices 1 to 4) or a table with r/g/b/a fields; the components are smoothed at a rate of 8. The outlines are always opaque (alpha 1), the decal has its alpha multiplied by 0.9 and a fade between 3.5 and 6 m.
The decals must be resubmitted every frame: update calls Engine.Render.DynamicDecalMgr.addDecals on each call (while visible is true).
This marker has no setMode or setToCheckpoint method: using it via scenario_race_marker.setModes or setToCheckpoints would fail.
update only takes dt (the color smoother depends on it). The outlines are not added to ScenarioObjectsGroup.
The extracted page shows setSpot(rot, scl); the actual signature is setSpot(pos, rot, scl).

C.desc: Parking spot marker with outlines and decal.

init.desc: Constructor: initializes position, rotation, size (2.5 x 5 x 0.5), colors and smoothers.

id.desc: Identifier, converted to a string (default 'parkingraceSpotMarker'), used in the object names.

createMarkers.desc: Removes the old objects then creates three TSStatic outlines (collision and decal disabled) and prepares the ground decal data.

clearMarkers.desc: Removes the outlines (after checking they still exist) and the decal data.

setSpot.desc: Configures the spot: position, rotation and size, applied to the outlines and the decal.

color.desc: {r, g, b, a} indexed 1 to 4 or with r/g/b/a fields.

update.desc: Per-frame call when visible: advances the color smoothers, colors the outlines and resubmits the decal to the dynamic decal manager.
